evidence.quote: The space is available to host local community groups

findings.value: Mostly hall hire for community groups: social clubs, a friendly bingo club, youth groups, parties and celebrations. No music nights were found.

evidence.quote: The versatile spaces hold events such as community activities, social clubs, youth groups, parties and celebrations.

not_found: website: no own website found; the council hub page is the only source
cost.notes: the council page gives no hire prices
postcode: not on the council page, so not part of this programme research
notes: Nights and events seen: 'Threads of Heritage: Family Craft Session and Community Celebration', Friday 30th October 2026 (16:00-19:00), a free workshop series by Numbi Arts CIC for Black History Month (council events page). The hub page says it has two large halls, one hall, two community rooms, a prayer room and a kitchen, bookable through the community booking team. Regular users named on the page are a Somali senior citizens club, a women's group, a bingo club and resident associations.
